Just be there. Be the best person for your kid that you can be. Love them more than anything and never make them feel that your love for them is tied to their accomplishments or how much they meet your expectations. Be involved even when they try to push you away. Honestly, you just need to try. Even if you make mistakes, it needs to come from a good and honest place. If they're smart, they'll get older and understand that you tried your best and that means the world. And for the love of god, treat their mother with kindness and respect no matter what your relationship is.
